 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 2 10-01-2023 Heard Mr. Krishna Prasad Singh, learned Senior Counsel and Mr. Jitendra Kumar Singh, APP who represents the State.

The petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Teghra P.S. Case No. 88 of 2022 instituted under sections 420, 467, 468, 469, 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 63, 65 of the Copy Right Act and Section 403, 104 of the Trademark Act and Section 50, 51, 52, 54, 61 of the FSSAI Act.

As per the prosecution story, Sri Om Agro Pvt. Ltd. Gwalior, complained to the concerned Sub-Divisional Officer as also the police station that the telephone brand which belonged to this Company is being used by the petitioner side and the wrappers have been found in the campus of Jai Mata Di Oil Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49966 of 2022(2) dt.10-01-2023 Mill, Teghra which is used for filling of their own oil which is violation of Copy Right Act.

entities.text: Jai Mata Di Oil Patna High Court
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Accordingly, the FIR.

Learned Senor Counsel submits that the case has been exaggerated inasmuch as he is dealing with business of oil in the name and style of Jai Mata Di Oil Mill, Teghra and has licence to this effect is valid up to 11.12.2022.
Further, he is an income tax assessee and the last income for the assessment year 2022-2023 was of Rs 17, 56,660/-.
However, he has been dragged in the case.

entities.text: Lakshman Kumar @ Lashman Kumar @ Laxman ... vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is his further submission is that even otherwise, the seized articles show that only four empty tins of telephone brand, a thick sheet of KUT, refine rice oil as also two pieces of wrappers of gol mohar brand were amongst other seized from the campus which in no where can implicate him inasmuch there are some tins that are being kept for using the oil for the machines and it was sheer co-incidence that it was telephone brand tins.

The learned APP on the other hand submits that the FIR was lodged on the complaint of the telephone brand maker Sri Om Agro Pvt. Ltd. Gwalior that the petitioner was using his brand to sell oil and as such he does not deserve any relief.

entities.text: Sri Om Agro Pvt. Ltd. Gwalior
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Taking into account the fact that the petitioner is an Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.49966 of 2022(2) dt.10-01-2023 Income Tax Assessee, is also having business of oil having license validity up to December, 22 and as per seizure list only four tins of telephone brand were recovered which he claims was kept for the machines and he does not have criminal antecedent, this Court is inclined to grant him relief.

Let the petitioner be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender within a period of four weeks from the receipt of this order, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 5,00,000/- (five lac) with two sureties of like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Begusarai, in connection with Teghra P.S. Case No. 88 of 2022 subject to the condition he may be submitted his passport, if any before the concerned Court and he will be available to the police as and when required for the purpose of investigation as also the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Rajiv Roy, J) Ravi/-
